QuestInfo.name: Cultivate a Mini Maple Tree!
QuestInfo.0: With the arrival of fall, #p9000021# wants to see you grow a Mini Maple Tree. Go see #r#p9000021##k.
QuestInfo.1: You obtained the Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal from #p9000021#. Now you just need a #bPotted Mini Maple Tree#k.
QuestInfo.2: You obtained the Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal from #p9000021#. Now you just need a #bPotted Mini Maple Tree#k.

0.0: Hello, #b#h0##k! How's it going?\r\n#L0##bEverything's pretty good. Hey, I heard you have some Mini Maple Trees.#l\n#k
0.1: Nothing gets past you, huh, #h0#? Yeah, I was thinking that fall is a good time for some nice Potted Mini Maple Trees. They make great decorations! Would you like to try to grow one yourself, #h0#? If you get a #rMini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal#k, I'll give you a tree of your own.

no.0: You must have a Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal before I can give you a Potted Mini Maple Tree. How else are you going to record your cultivating adventures?

yes.0: If you click the Mini Maple Tree Cultivation Journal in the ETC tab, you can check your rewards received, and how many entries you've made. Every day that you grow your Potted Mini Maple Tree and get a #bGolden Maple Fruit from it, you can make one entry in the Cultivation Journal#k.
yes.1: Right, so, I'll get you set up with a Potted Mini Maple Tree, #e#b#h0##k#n. Talk to me by #bclicking the Event Notifier on the left side of your screen#k when you are ready!

default.0: Shouldn't you see if you have an Etc slot free?
